title: Rationale
html:
Rationale

China blockades or attacks Taiwan by May 18, 2027

A blockade, quarantine or strike that stops short of invasion. Polymarket's 'China blockade Taiwan in 2026' trades near 2% for six weeks, which is mostly the floor such longshots trade at; Bloomberg Economics calls heightened tension without a full crisis 'the most probable near-term path'. Xi pressed Taiwan with Trump on Nov 19 ('the United States must keep doing the right thing to avoid the emergence of great turbulence'), which is pressure through Washington, not a sign of imminent force. I put it at 1.5% over six months.
